title: Sindh Parliamentary Secretaries Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1996

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Parliamentary Secretaries Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 1996
ACT VII OF 1996
SINDH PARLIAMENTARY SECRETARIES (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act to amend the Sindh Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 13th March, 1996]
No.PAS/Legis-B-2/96, dated
13-3-1996.--The Sindh Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries Allowances and
Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 4th February, 1996 and assented to by the Governor of
Sindh on 25th February, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature
of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
(Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Parliamentary Secretaries Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of Sindh Act XXIV of 1974

ACT VII OF 1996
ACT VII OF 1996
SINDH PARLIAMENTARY SECRETARIES (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act to amend the Sindh Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 13th March, 1996]
No.PAS/Legis-B-2/96, dated
13-3-1996.--The Sindh Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries Allowances and
Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 4th February, 1996 and assented to by the Governor of
Sindh on 25th February, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature
of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 3 of Sindh Act XXIV of 1974.--In the Sindh
Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974,
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, for section 3, the following shall be
substituted:--
"3. Salary
and Privilege.--A Parliamentary Secretary shall be entitled to.-
(i) a salary
of ten thousand one hundred and ninety rupees per month; and
(ii) an
orderly allowance of one thousand rupees per month up to and inclusive of 31st
August, 1995 and one thousand and six hundred rupees per month with effect from
1st September, 1995.
(iii) the use
of an official car of 1300 cc (indigenously manufactured) with a Driver maintained
at Government expense.".

3. Amendment of section 4-A of Sindh Act XXIV of 1974.--In the said
